name: La Francophonie (OIF)
description: A white field bearing a central ring of five curved bands separated by gaps — green, purple, red, light blue and yellow.
history: Flag of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie, the association of French-speaking states and governments. The circular form conveys coming together and the five interlocking segments stand for the five continents on which members are found; the colours are drawn from the flags of the participating states and governments.

features.role: ring of five curved bands in green, purple, red, light blue and yellow
features.symbolism: the five continents on which the members of La Francophonie are found
